stemMd: What is 9 to the fourth power divided by 27 squared?
explanationMd: Rewrite in base 3: 9 to the fourth is 3 to the eighth, and 27 squared is 3 to the sixth. Their quotient is 3 squared=9.

distractorRationale.e: This ignores part of the denominator exponent.
distractorRationale.a: The two powers are not equal.
distractorRationale.b: This subtracts the resulting exponents incorrectly.
distractorRationale.d: This leaves an exponent of three instead of two.
